name: arize-phoenix
description: Investigate and manage traces, datasets, experiments, prompts, and annotations in Phoenix.

interface.shortDescription: Debug AI applications with Phoenix data.
interface.longDescription: Investigate failures, inspect traces and sessions, compare experiments, and manage datasets, prompts, and annotations in your Phoenix instance.
defaultPrompt: Find failed traces from the last 24 hours and summarize the most common errors.
Compare my two latest experiments on evaluation scores, latency, and cost.
Show me the slowest LLM spans in my project and identify likely bottlenecks.
